name: heldout
purpose: Held-out staples (not in the food table, half of them traps): does the table answer foods it doesn't hold, and how good are the cascade and today's fill on staples outside the table, on 3.5 and 3.1 Flash-Lite?

variants.describe: The app today: one Gemini call with Google Search, the model decides whether to search (src/lib/macro-fill.ts SYSTEM_PROMPT).
Today's prompt with no search tool. The floor on cost, and the accuracy of Gemini's own knowledge.
Two-step fill from functions/src/ai-prompt.ts: ROUTING_PROMPT without search answers or hands over; SEARCH_PROMPT with search runs only after a hand-over.
Our USDA food table first: Jev picks the food and portion and code does the sums; a miss (no match, "none", Jev unsure, not a single food) falls back to the cascade.
Full hybrid: Jev routes; brands go to SEARCH_PROMPT with search, staples try the food table first, and everything else (and table misses) goes through the cascade.
